source_snapshot.procedure: Apply six EDKII settings, install an x4-bit DIMM, deploy Intel ITP, boot Windows, run mc.dimminfo(), then halt, inject rank-0 x4sddc at socket/channel/dimm/sub_channel and resume.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains normal; BMC identifies the DIMM slot with a correctable error; front-panel and corresponding DIMM lightpath remain off; uEFI SEL identifies the slot if supported.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek identifies the proprietary harness and critical risk, but its evidence path uses insecure SSH and truncated Linux dmesg on a Windows procedure, omits physical x4-DIMM/controller mapping and cannot prove slot attribution or negative LED behavior.

original_test_intent.purpose: Inject the approved correctable x4 SDDC memory error at rank 0 for every owner-required memory-controller target and verify normal operation, correct physical-slot attribution in BMC and conditional uEFI SEL, and no front-panel or target-DIMM lightpath assertion.
original_test_intent.target: Every memory controller labeled 1 through N in the approved platform map, each resolved to an exact socket, channel, DIMM, sub-channel, rank-0 tuple and physical x4-organized DIMM slot/serial/part number.
original_test_intent.scope: Approved x4 DIMM population, six BIOS injection settings, Intel ITP/Cscripts client, one bounded `errType="x4sddc"` invocation per required controller tuple, complete harness/Windows/BMC/uEFI/indicator evidence, and restoration of BIOS and memory population. It excludes adjacent UCE, patrol scrub, x8 SDDC, mirror, parity and leaky-bucket variants.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve baselines, have a qualified operator establish and verify the signed x4 DIMM population, apply BIOS settings, boot Windows and use `mc.dimminfo()` to bind physical slots to injection parameters. Sequentially halt, inject rank-0 x4sddc and resume for each approved controller tuple, gating the next target on correctable behavior, exact slot logs, both LEDs off and stable health; then restore the signed final configuration.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source estimates 15 attended and 15 machine minutes. Iteration count is one approved injection per controller tuple in the owner matrix; N, per-target timeout and whether DIMMs must be physically repositioned between controller targets are undefined and cannot be inferred from the estimates.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each injected x4 SDDC event remains correctable, is attributed to the exact intended physical DIMM slot in BMC and uEFI SEL when supported, does not assert the front-panel or corresponding DIMM fault light, and leaves the system normally operational with no unrelated or persistent memory fault.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Platform/controller/slot topology; x4 DIMM organization, part/serial and population/ESD records; BIOS/tool/client/Windows identities; baseline/export/clear audit; full `mc.dimminfo()` and per-controller parameter mapping; complete halt/inject/go logs; Windows-native hardware-error evidence if required by the owner; raw BMC and uEFI SEL slot records; front-panel and per-DIMM LED observations; recovery/restoration/final health.
ambiguities: Controller count N and the mapping from controller labels to socket/channel/DIMM/sub-channel and physical slot are absent.
The source names a singular x4 DIMM but does not state whether one static population covers all controllers or whether one/more modules must be moved or installed per target.
The x4 DIMM part/organization, supported rank-0 target, expected record signatures and per-target timing are absent.
The source boots Windows but its generic pre/post examples name dmesg/syslog; the exact Windows-native unexpected-log path is not defined.
The final BIOS settings and x4 DIMM population are not specified.
source_conflicts: The explicit execution OS is Windows, while generic before/after log examples include Linux dmesg/syslog. These cannot be used as the Windows-native evidence path without owner correction; the acceptance criteria themselves require BMC/uEFI slot records and do not require dmesg.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly preserves x4 DIMM installation, x4sddc semantics, per-target injection, slot attribution, indicator negatives, critical safety and restoration. It incorrectly adds dmesg/EDAC to an explicit Windows run, does not mark the log-template conflict and does not make the controller-to-physical-DIMM population matrix or possible repositioning an explicit gate.

applicable_history.decision: The row-specific x4sddc record is distinct from adjacent same-title uncorrectable ECC, patrol scrub, x8 SDDC, mirror, parity and leaky-bucket variants. Only source_ref Reliability row 16 governs this case.
Fault-injection targets require immutable physical/logical mapping; conflicting OS evidence must be marked rather than mixed, and a physical setup plus automated evidence remains REQUIRES.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep REQUIRES but block execution until the owner supplies the controller-to-slot/x4-DIMM population matrix and resolves the Windows-native log path. Preserve one rank-0 x4sddc injection per approved controller, exact slot attribution, both negative LED criteria and complete restoration.

available_now: The six BIOS settings, physical x4-DIMM requirement, Windows/ITP/Cscripts flow, exact x4sddc call shape and four acceptance behaviors are explicit.
Read-only platform/memory topology, DIMM SPD/part identity, current BIOS values, logs, indicators and recovery readiness can be collected before physical change or injection.
missing_inputs: The Intel/platform owner must supply controller labels 1~N mapped to socket/channel/DIMM/sub-channel/rank0 and physical slot/serial, plus whether and how x4 DIMM population changes between targets.
The FAE must supply supported ITP/Cscripts build/hash, exact API/target semantics, expected correctable record and cleanup behavior, per-target timeout and go/no-go rules.

The system/BMC owner must resolve Windows-native unexpected-log evidence, BMC/uEFI slot signatures, indicator behavior and conditional uEFI support; the lab owner must supply ESD/power sequence, BIOS/memory restoration, approvals and recovery.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: Intel/FAE owns injection semantics; platform/memory owner owns controller/slot/x4-DIMM mapping and population; BMC/system owner owns evidence; lab owner owns physical work, authorization and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record CPU/controller/channel/slot topology, full DIMM SPD/part/serial/organization evidence, BIOS/BMC/Windows/tool identity, current logs and both indicator states without changing population or clearing evidence.
Inspect and hash the Cscripts package offline and reconcile `mc.dimminfo()` examples with the owner topology without attaching, halting or injecting.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not infer x4 organization from capacity/name, guess controller indices or slot mapping, install/move DIMMs, change BIOS, attach ITP, halt/inject/go, mix Windows with Linux dmesg evidence, import adjacent patterns, clear logs, auto-loop controllers, continue after wrong attribution/indicator behavior or restore before preserving evidence.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Sign the controller/tuple/physical-slot/population matrix, Windows-native evidence and expected record/indicator rules; verify x4 part and ESD plan, proprietary tool, baseline, stops and recovery; then execute one target at a time with complete evidence and restore signed BIOS/population/final health.

revision_candidate.test_name: Intel Correctable x4 SDDC Injection Across Memory Controllers
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject one approved rank-0 x4 SDDC error for every required memory-controller target and verify correctable slot-specific reporting with both fault indicators remaining off.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact supported multi-controller Intel platform with owner-approved x4-organized DIMM population, BIOS/BMC/firmware, Windows version, controlled Intel ITP/Cscripts client and dedicated recovery-capable SUT.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every controller in the signed 1~N matrix, each mapped to one socket/channel/DIMM/sub-channel/rank-0 tuple and physical slot/serial. One `errType="x4sddc"` injection per tuple, sequentially. Exclude adjacent UCE, patrol-scrub, x8, mirror, parity and leaky-bucket patterns. Treat 15/15 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Platform/controller topology; physical slot and x4 DIMM part/serial/organization/population matrix; whether relocation is required; six BIOS values/restore plan; ITP/Cscripts build/hash/API/client; exact per-target command; expected correctable Windows/BMC/uEFI records and slot encoding; LED rules; timeout/go-no-go; log policy; ESD/power plan; approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash Windows/BMC/uEFI logs before an approved clear, or use an approved timestamp marker. A qualified operator establishes the signed x4 population and six BIOS settings. Boot the supported Windows image, capture full `mc.dimminfo()` and verify each parameter-to-physical-slot mapping. For each controller tuple, create a unique full log, halt the correct target, run the exact rank-0 x4sddc injection, resume immediately and collect unfiltered harness, Windows-native, BMC/uEFI and front-panel/DIMM-light evidence before the next go/no-go. Restore the signed BIOS and memory population after all approved targets.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Windows-native log path resolved; exact controller/slot/population matrix and x4 part verified; tool/API/expected records approved; dedicated idle SUT; backups and logs preserved; safe power/ESD controls, clocks/storage, physical observer, console/OOB and recovery proven; installation/BIOS/injection/reset approvals recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/hash and signed matrix; x4 DIMM SPD/part/serial and population photos; ESD/power timeline; BIOS before/during/after; baseline/clear audit; full `mc.dimminfo()`; per-tuple exact parameters and halt/inject/go log; Windows-native error record if specified; raw BMC and uEFI SEL with decoded physical slot; front-panel and target-DIMM LED-off evidence; health, abort/recovery and restored final configuration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The FAE/platform-approved x4 SDDC recipe and slot/event matrix for the exact platform, constrained by source criteria: normal operation, correct physical slot in BMC, front-panel and corresponding DIMM lightpath off, and correct slot in uEFI SEL when supported.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Critical physical and fault-injection work on a dedicated SUT only. Do not use unknown/non-x4 DIMMs, force/reseat live hardware, guess controller/slot indices, mix OS evidence, import another pattern, expose secrets, filter evidence, leave the target halted, auto-loop, continue after misattribution/indicator assertion/instability or perform unapproved reset/restoration/rerun.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Hardware owner approves x4 module/population and any relocation; FAE approves tool/API and every target; operator performs power/ESD-safe DIMM and BIOS work and observes LEDs. Log clear, halt/injection/resume, each next target, recovery and final restoration require the signed approval/go-no-go policy.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator handles DIMM installation/relocation, BIOS, physical LEDs and recovery; FAE controls proprietary targeting. Automation may inventory, retain full logs and correlate `mc.dimminfo()`, Windows, BMC and uEFI evidence against the supplied map.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong module/slot/target, halt/resume failure, uncorrectable event, crash/no-boot, persistent fault or LED/log mismatch, stop the matrix, preserve evidence, use approved OOB recovery, power down before hardware work and restore only through the signed BIOS/population plan after FAE/hardware-owner review.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved OS-log or controller/population mapping; wrong/non-x4 DIMM or rank/tuple; tool/API/BIOS mismatch; missing approval/recovery/evidence; failed baseline; resume failure; uncorrectable or misattributed event; front-panel or DIMM light assertion; missing/mismatched BMC record, or missing/mismatched uEFI SEL record only when the signed platform matrix declares that uEFI SEL reporting is supported and required; crash/reset/hang, thermal/power/memory instability; or failed BIOS/population restoration/final boot.

identified_defects: DeepSeek collects insecure truncated Linux evidence for an explicit Windows execution and cannot establish physical slot attribution or negative indicators.
V2 adds dmesg/EDAC without resolving the Windows/native evidence path.
The source and V2 do not define how controller 1~N maps to injection parameters and one or more physical x4 DIMMs, including possible relocation.
N, per-target timing, x4 part/organization, exact record signatures and final population are absent.
Same-title adjacent variants create a critical wrong-pattern risk if source_ref is ignored.
reason_for_change: Ensure every controller is tied to an exact x4 physical DIMM and rank-0 injection tuple, preserve Windows-native and dual-SEL slot evidence, and prevent Linux-log substitution or adjacent-pattern reuse in a critical memory RAS test.

new_technical_evidence.title: Querying the System Event Log for Hardware Error Events
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Windows execution explicitly named by this source
new_technical_evidence.supports: Windows WHEA hardware errors are retrieved from Windows Event Log providers; V2's Linux dmesg/EDAC evidence is not a Windows-native substitute.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The owner has not specified whether a Windows WHEA record is required in addition to source-mandated BMC/uEFI evidence or which fields identify x4sddc.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00736-V003
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source fixes rank=0 and errType=x4sddc, requires x4 DIMM installation, normal operation, physical-slot logging and both indicators off.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Controller/population matrix, N and record details are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Requires a controller-to-injection-parameter-to-physical-slot/serial matrix and states whether DIMM relocation is needed.
Preserves rank=0 and one x4sddc invocation per approved controller rather than generic ECC injection.
Separates BMC SEL and conditional uEFI SEL and makes both negative LED observations explicit.
Rejects Linux dmesg/EDAC as Windows-native evidence and isolates adjacent same-title variants.
resolved_blockers: The physical/proprietary dependencies remain provider-closable, so the capability stays REQUIRES rather than BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits resolution of OS log handling, complete controller/slot/x4 population mapping, approved tool/records/timing, ESD/physical plan, authorization and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 closes the controller-to-physical-DIMM coverage gap, removes incompatible Linux evidence from a Windows run and prevents a different same-title memory fault recipe from being executed or accepted.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The first isolated pass recovered the intended matrix, Windows path, physical-slot evidence and negative LED criteria but found that Stop Conditions made uEFI SEL unconditional despite Acceptance Reference saying `when supported`. V3 corrected the rule so absent/mismatched uEFI SEL stops only when the signed platform matrix declares it supported and required. Fresh contract-only revalidation recovered that distinction, one injection per tuple, no auto-loop, full restoration and no partial PASS.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow read-only topology/SPD/tool/baseline work; prohibit DIMM movement, BIOS unlock, ITP/injection or log clear until exact mapping, Windows evidence, approvals and recovery are closed.
